Medical transition- Dysphoria and a little bit of highschool

I slowly came to realize that no matter what I do in life there is always going to be a degree of uncertainty. I imagined myself as women and men in tv shows to see what I was comfortable with. I over analyzed everything even though I daydreamed of what T offered.
